subject: sentences
title: One or Many: Runs or Run
about: Making the action word match: one dog runs, two dogs run; the cup is, the cups are; one duck was, six ducks were; the cat has, the cats have. Subject-verb agreement in basic sentences is the first row of NC's K-1 grammar continuum under L.1.1, and this level builds on The right little word.
tip: Ask how many first (one, or more than one), then read the sentence aloud with his choice in it and ask if it sounds right.

cards.sayQ: The dog, blank, fast. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: One dog, so the action word gets an s: the dog runs.

cards.sayQ: The dogs, blank, fast. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: More than one dog, so no s on the action word: the dogs run.

cards.sayQ: One frog, blank, on the log. Which word goes in the blank?
cards.note: Just one frog, so the action word gets an s: one frog hops.

cards.sayQ: Two frogs, blank, on the log. Which word goes in the blank?
cards.note: Two frogs, so no s: two frogs hop.

cards.q: Mia ___ a song to her cat.
cards.sayQ: Mia, blank, a song to her cat. Pick the word that fits.
cards.note: One person, Mia, so the action word gets an s: Mia sings.

cards.sayQ: Mia and Ben, blank, a song. Pick the word that fits.
cards.note: Mia and Ben are two people, so no s: they sing.

cards.q: Pick the word: The cup ___ full.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The cup, blank, full.
cards.note: One cup, so we say is. One thing is; more than one are.

cards.q: Pick the word: The cups ___ full.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The cups, blank, full.
cards.note: More than one cup, so we say are.

cards.q: Yesterday one duck ___ in the pond.
cards.sayQ: Yesterday one duck, blank, in the pond. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: One duck, and it already happened, so we say was.

cards.q: Yesterday six ducks ___ in the pond.
cards.sayQ: Yesterday six ducks, blank, in the pond. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Six ducks, more than one, so we say were.

cards.q: Pick the word: The cat ___ a soft bed.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The cat, blank, a soft bed.
cards.note: One cat, so we say has. One has; more than one have.

cards.q: Pick the word: The cats ___ soft beds.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The cats, blank, soft beds.
cards.note: More than one cat, so we say have.
One bird, so sings with an s. Birds, more than one, would go with sing.
More than one kid, so jump with no s. One kid would get jumps.

cards.q: Pick the sentence that sounds right.
Pick the one that sounds right.
cards.note: More than one pig, so are. One pig would be is.
